The plug-in pedestal system offers the most flexible seating position options of all pedestals available from BLA. Any number of seating positions can be chosen by the simple addition of the base of your choice. Manufactured from a combination of aluminium, stainless steel and glass filled nylon. Plug-in ensures years of maintenance free performance. 
Plug-in Power Rise Pedestal 
System matched with plug-in bases, this pedestal features gas operated height adjustment and air-ride comfort. 
Features 
• Instantaneous height adjustment 
• Gas suspension ride 
• 6º angled seat position 
• 360º swivel 
Dimensions 
• 60mm lower pedestal post 
• Post recesses into base by 53mm
